resources.string: Apps will close and the phone will start up again.
Your power button is missing, so you may not be able to turn the phone back on. Some phones start up when plugged into a charger. Check yours before relying on it.
Bubble hidden. Bring it back with the accessibility shortcut, the Power bubble Quick Settings tile, or by holding the Power Bubble app icon.
Shows a floating button that turns the screen off and opens restart and shut down controls. It replaces a broken power button. Power Bubble doesn\'t read what\'s on your screen.
Turn on Power Bubble in Accessibility settings first.
A floating replacement for a broken power button.
On. The bubble can turn the screen off.
Off. Turn on Power Bubble in Accessibility settings.
Switch greyed out? Android blocks accessibility for sideloaded apps until you allow it. Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Shizuku isn\'t running. Install it and start it with Wireless debugging.
Shizuku is running. Power Bubble needs its permission.
Ready. Restart and Shut down work directly.
Without Shizuku, Restart and Shut down open the system power menu instead. Shizuku stops when the phone restarts, so start it again from the Shizuku app afterwards.
Turn the screen off (hold for the menu)
Getting it back after you hide it

• The accessibility shortcut (the accessibility button, gesture or volume keys) shows and hides the bubble. Set one up under Accessibility › Power Bubble › Power Bubble shortcut.\n• The Power bubble Quick Settings tile.\n• Hold the Power Bubble app icon and choose Show / hide bubble.
Flat Loud colors with dark ink outlines and hard offset shadows. Choose square or rounded corners below. Gesture actions and power controls work as before.
Clear glass: barely blurred, a light tint and a bright rim. Android can\'t show an overlay what\'s behind it, so it can\'t bend it like the launcher\'s glass does.
Blurs what\'s behind the bubble under a light tint, like the launcher\'s Blur panels.
A plain see-through dark circle, no blur.
Your phone isn\'t allowing blur right now (it\'s off in battery saver, and on some phones under Developer options), so Glass and Blur use a darker tint instead.
